proved_summary: In exact rank three, after the B16 true-near-coloop reduction c>63/64, any physical diagonal |A_jj|>=1/64 is paid by the completed rank-three all-residual-orientations theorem with density <=1024.

If all physical diagonals are <1/64 but some hub-star coefficient |A_0j|>=1/16, the literal physical pair is indefinite with |det|>15/4096 and sigma_min>3/64, so the pair-log theorem gives density <157.
The only survivor has hub star energy >4031/4096 and normalized atom masses <16/4031<1/251, hence at least 252 nonzero hub-star leaves.

The survivor admits 80 disjoint original-coordinate banks with normalized star mass in [1/120,1/80), within-bank maximum normalized coefficient squared <1920/4031<1/2, mutually independent normalized aggregate variables of density <=sqrt(2), and bank star norms sigma_k>0.0905598724.
